evidence_vs_inference_impact: OBSERVED EVIDENCE: Multiple independent commuters cite specific abusive conduct, premature drop-offs of female employees before destinations, and unreachable transport helpdesks. INFERENCE: Severe passenger vulnerability, heightened corporate liability, and brand trust erosion during late-night shift commutes.
immediate_next_day_action: FDE Day-1 Action: Request joint triage session with MoveInSync Fleet Safety Operations; request trip telematics for incident review [REDACTED: Vehicle Registration]; request 60-day safety ticket escalation backlog to audit human response times.
technical_investigation_lead: Fleet Safety Operations, Compliance & Transport Desk Product Lead
required_telemetry_and_records: Trip telematics GPS logs for cited incident dates; Transport helpdesk telephony call connection and abandonment logs; Vendor driver onboarding/KYC verification records; In-app SOS trigger alert dispatch timestamps.

Priority SOS voice bridge with guaranteed human operator callback.

dependencies_and_risks: Dependencies: Third-party fleet vendor contractual cooperation; Client corporate HR safety policies. Risks: Overly rigid automated rules without human review could unfairly penalize drivers in legitimate GPS dead zones or emergency diversions.

issue_name: Live GPS Tracking Stagnation, Map Freezes & Inaccurate 'Teleporting' ETAs
representative_excerpts: 'Can't do live tracking or live boarding activities. suddenly it shows up at your location. You guys loved surprises huh??!!!' | 'ETA calculator very bad. not sure on what basis its done. google maps always shows 3x the time shown in moveinsync app.'
evidence_vs_inference_impact: OBSERVED EVIDENCE: Commuters report vehicle map markers freezing in place, sudden arrival without warning, and internal ETAs that underestimate travel times by up to 3x compared to Google Maps. INFERENCE: Severe passenger anxiety, missed cabs, and commuter abandonment of the tracking interface.
immediate_next_day_action: FDE Day-1 Action: Request a 24-hour anonymized telemetry extract of Driver Lite location broadcast timestamps and WebSocket server connection drop logs to evaluate ping intervals during background execution.
technical_investigation_lead: Mobile Core (Android Telematics) & Real-Time Ingestion Backend Lead
required_telemetry_and_records: Driver Lite foreground vs background GPS ping transmission intervals; WebSocket drop and reconnection error logs; Driver device battery optimization exemption logs; Comparative delta between MoveInSync internal ETA and actual trip duration across 5,000 trips.
recommended_conditional_fix: Phase A (Investigation): Test driver background location retention across top driver device OEMs (Xiaomi, Vivo, Samsung) to confirm whether OS Doze mode is throttling GPS pings. Phase B (Conditional Fixes): 1. If background throttling is confirmed, harden Driver Lite Foreground Service with explicit battery optimization guidance. 2. Implement Client Stale Telemetry Indicator: If location ping is unreceived for >45s, display visual chip: 'Reconnecting to cab... Last updated 1m ago' rather than freezing the icon. 3. If ETA errors correlate with traffic congestion, calibrate internal routing speed models against dynamic traffic APIs.
measurable_success_metric: Provisional Target: GPS Telemetry Freshness (p95 ping latency <15s); Tracking Stagnation UI Warning Availability >99%; ETA Mean Absolute Error (MAE <5 minutes across 85% of peak-hour trips).
review_cadence: Weekly telematics accuracy review; Sprint-level engineering benchmarks.
dependencies_and_risks: Dependencies: Android OS background execution limits (Android 14/15); OEM power management. Risks: Excessively frequent GPS polling could accelerate driver phone battery drain, provoking driver resistance.

issue_name: Vehicle Assignment Latency, Pickup Unpunctuality & Multi-Stop Detours
representative_excerpts: 'MoveOutSync doesn't plan commutes; it plans cross-country pilgrimages. The ETA is an abstract joke where a 1-hour delay is considered punctual. The routes make you tour the entire city before dropping you home.' | 'When trying to reach helpdesk, the line disconnects. Cab ETA keeps changing and the worst part is routing & pickup timings, spending over 2 hours to reach office.'
evidence_vs_inference_impact: OBSERVED EVIDENCE: Represents the largest volume of negative complaints (27 reviews). Users report 1-hour delays, last-minute cab assignments, and excessive multi-stop detours turning 30-min rides into 2-hour commutes. INFERENCE: Employee productivity loss, shift absenteeism penalties, and commuter fatigue.
immediate_next_day_action: FDE Day-1 Action: Request dispatch fulfillment metrics and planned vs actual trip duration distributions for peak shift windows (07:00-09:00 and 19:00-21:00) over the past 14 days.
technical_investigation_lead: Routing & Optimization Algorithm Backend Lead & Fleet Operations Planner
required_telemetry_and_records: Trip assignment latency distribution (cutoff time to driver assignment); Planned Route Duration vs Actual Route Duration (Detour Ratio); Driver trip acceptance/rejection timestamps; Fleet supply vs demand ratio per corporate hub.
recommended_conditional_fix: Phase A (Investigation): Run solver simulation to analyze the trade-off between pooling seat occupancy and individual passenger travel time. Phase B (Conditional Fixes): 1. Implement Policy-Calibrated Detour Cap: Limit shared route detours to max 1.5x of direct route duration. 2. Advance Assignment Notification: Shift automated allocation notification from ~15 minutes to 30-45 minutes prior to pickup where fleet availability permits. 3. Smart Buffer Allocation on high-congestion corridors.
measurable_success_metric: Provisional Target: On-Time Pickup Rate (-5m to +5m window) >90%; Shared Commute Detour Ratio <1.4x for 90% of commuters; Cab Assignment Notification Lead Time >30 mins for 95% of trips.
review_cadence: Weekly dispatch operations review; Monthly route efficiency audit.
dependencies_and_risks: Dependencies: Fleet vehicle supply agreements with contracted vendors; Client shift timing compliance. Risks: Capping detour ratios without increasing vehicle supply could leave some commuters unallocated.

issue_name: Authentication Lockout, OTP Non-Delivery & Session Invalidation
representative_excerpts: 'Such a worst app. I am not receiving the OTP even after trying multiple times. Because of this, I am unable to complete the login/verification process.' | 'Unable to login in the App. Both Mobile Otp and Email OTP options are not working'
evidence_vs_inference_impact: OBSERVED EVIDENCE: 19 independent negative reviews report complete inability to receive verification codes via SMS or email, leading to total access lockout. INFERENCE: Commuters miss shift bookings, drivers cannot start duty on time, and users abandon the app in frustration.
immediate_next_day_action: FDE Day-1 Action: Request 7-day SMS gateway delivery receipt (DLR) logs and carrier-level latency reports from the platform gateway team to establish empirical delivery failure baselines.
technical_investigation_lead: Identity, Security & Platform Communications Gateway Lead
required_telemetry_and_records: SMS Aggregator SMPP logs (Delivery Receipts, error codes, carrier response times); TRAI DLT template registration and scrub failure logs; Email OTP delivery latency logs; Auth service rate-limiter rejection metrics.
recommended_conditional_fix: Phase A (Investigation): Inspect SMS gateway DLR logs to determine if failures stem from telecom DLT template scrubbing, carrier congestion, or aggressive auth rate-limiting. Phase B (Conditional Fixes): 1. Multi-Channel Fallback: If SMS delivery acknowledgment is unreceived after 30 seconds, dynamically offer 'Send OTP via WhatsApp' or 'Voice Call OTP'. 2. Enterprise SSO: Accelerate SAML/OAuth integration for corporate clients to allow passwordless email login. 3. Fix session refresh token persistence to prevent unnecessary logouts post-update.
measurable_success_metric: Provisional Target: OTP Delivery Success Rate >99.0%; p95 Delivery Latency <20 seconds; Auth Gateway Error Rate <0.5%.
review_cadence: Weekly gateway health review; Real-time PagerDuty alerting on OTP failure rate >3%.
dependencies_and_risks: Dependencies: Third-party SMS aggregators (Gupshup, Twilio, Exotel); Telecom carrier DLT compliance in India. Risks: Secondary channels (WhatsApp/Voice) introduce incremental operational messaging costs.
